name: PAF Airman Test Practice
fullName: Pakistan Air Force airman recruitment (initial) academic and intelligence test
notes: 4 tests x 50 = 200, every item used once in tests (no spares). The PAF publishes no syllabus, question count, time or pass mark for the airman initial test, and joinpaf.gov.pk and paf.gov.pk did not load (HTTP 503) when checked on 2026-11-05. Guides (not confirmed) describe an academic test (English, maths, physics for technical trades) and verbal and non-verbal intelligence tests at a PAF Selection and Recruitment Centre, then medical and interview. 4 x 50 at 70% (35 of 50) is Tigertest's target; weights are Tigertest's own. Non-verbal items are written as text patterns. GK lane in this batch: PAF ranks and institutions, aviation and flight basics, physics and electricity (ppsc has Pakistan Studies and the Constitution; punjabpolice Punjab and law; pakarmy the Army, everyday science, Islamiat). Dashboard = 5 sets + 4 tests = 9 steps.
